name: What are the common signs of rain damage on a roof that require an inspection?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of rain damage on a roof that require an inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of rain damage include missing or displaced shingles, dark or wet spots on ceilings or walls inside your home, clogged gutters, and excessive shingle granules in your downspouts or yard. You might also notice a musty odor in the attic, indicating moisture or mold. Even subtle changes, like warped or curling shingles, can indicate water penetration. If you observe any of these indicators, particularly after a heavy storm in areas like Dallas or Fort Worth, it's a strong signal that a professional inspection is needed to prevent further damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs of rain damage include missing shingles, interior water stains, clogged gutters, excessive shingle granules, and musty attic odors. Any of these warrant a professional roof inspection.
